goals.summary: Handle missing payloads and non-UTF-8 bytes cleanly in WebSocketEndpoint.decode() when configured for JSON

facets.summary: When WebSocketEndpoint uses JSON encoding, decode() accepts text frames or UTF-8 encoded binary frames. Previously, missing text assumed bytes were present and valid UTF-8.

Empty events (no text or bytes) caused AttributeError/KeyError, and invalid UTF-8 bytes triggered an unhandled UnicodeDecodeError. Both bypassed the unsupported data closure (1003) and raised 1011 internal server errors with tracebacks.
Checks for bytes before decoding and catches UnicodeDecodeError to close with WS_1003_UNSUPPORTED_DATA and raise RuntimeError('Malformed JSON data received.'), mirroring text JSON handling.
Author reports verification with test scripts passing all 1253 tests with 100% coverage, alongside clean linting and type checks.
